# CSATv2

**Category:** Hybrid · **Code:**
[`timm/models/csatv2.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/csatv2.py) ·
**Architectures:** 2 · **Pretrained weights:** 3 (0 with ImageNet-1k results)

CSATv2 is a frequency-domain vision model that works on DCT transforms of the input image, with spatial attention.

## Papers

The module docstring does not reference any papers.

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('csatv2.r512_in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```

## Pretrained weights

the listed eval size, - if the weight has no ImageNet-1k result (e.g. pretraining or image-text weights). Classes is the
size of the pretrained classifier, none for weights without one.
